caption:
Big week on the bike? Toto's quads, hips and calves feel completely cooked.

Hours of pedalling load the front of the thighs, the hip flexors, glutes and calves. Remedial massage can ease that tight, heavy feeling and help you move more comfortably between rides. Keep it lighter the day before an event and save deeper work for recovery days.

Massage complements rest, sleep, sensible training load and strength work rather than replacing them.

Knee pain, tingling or a swollen calf are worth getting checked first. Our remedial massage therapists can tailor a session to your riding week. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
